== shadowing
  q1 p NXDOMAIN NXDOMAIN x.sub.test. [] ['x.sub.test.']
  q2 p NOERROR NODATA sub.test. [] ['sub.test.']
  q3 p NXDOMAIN NXDOMAIN w.sub.test. [] ['w.sub.test.']
  q4 p NOERROR ANSWER w.test. [('w.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.99')] ['w.test.']

== cross-zone wildcard
  q o NXDOMAIN NXDOMAIN w.sub.test. [('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'w.sub.test.')] ['c.test.', 'w.sub.test.']
  q p NOERROR ANSWER w.sub.test. [('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'w.sub.test.'), ('w.sub.test.', 'A', '198.51.100.5')] ['c.test.', 'w.sub.test.']
  diag {'equivalence': [['o'], ['p']], 'basis': ['q'], 'cost': 1, 'count': 1}
== 3-cycle
  q p3 SERVFAIL LOOP a.test. [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'), ('b.test.', 'CNAME', 'c.test.'), ('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'a.test.')] ['a.test.', 'b.test.', 'c.test.', 'a.test.']
  q p9 SERVFAIL LOOP a.test. [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'), ('b.test.', 'CNAME', 'c.test.'), ('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'a.test.')] ['a.test.', 'b.test.', 'c.test.', 'a.test.']
  diag {'equivalence': [['p3', 'p9']], 'basis': [], 'cost': 0, 'count': 0}
